spec_dod.text: A freshly-issued mobile-app session for `grace` is accepted on the very next authenticated request.
A session idle for longer than 15 minutes is rejected on the next request, requiring re-authentication.
Logging out `grace` invalidates that session immediately — a request replayed with the same (now-logged-out) session token is rejected.
Two concurrent sessions for `grace` (e.g. two devices) are independent — logging out one does not invalidate the other.
The session-expired message tells the user what happened without sounding like a security alarm.
An unrelated read-only endpoint touched incidentally by this flow behaves as documented elsewhere (distractor — not part of this case's seeded defect).
A concurrent, unrelated request against a different resource is unaffected by this flow (distractor — not part of this case's seeded defect).
